nodes.text: What Is Millwork Painting?

Millwork might sound like a historic piece of furniture, but it’s a common decorative piece almost every house has. In a nutshell, millwork is any decorative material made from wood-mill. This includes window trims, door trims, moldings, baseboards, cabinetries, stairways, wainscoting, and so on.
